digest.component_or_area: Jira DC adapter / capability & probe infrastructure
propositions: Epic-field contract validation must occur post-run and refuse unvouchable reports with non-zero exit and verdict in run_metadata.json, not via pre-run await gates.
Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary and hasattr fallback; capability-absent vs capability-raised must report distinctly on bridge_alerts rather than fail silently.

The dormant inbound absence-probe port including SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, and probe_remote implementations must be deleted; affected config keys jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses require deprecation path.
None of the three delivered changes regress the live DC harness; pre-existing failures stem from commit c87afedba8 and are tracked separately on ticket 9590.
The live DC harness contains exactly one xfail marker (from ticket 2b16, not this epic) and no deleted or skipped cells; full cell census matches exit-bar canary.
